initialExam.title: NVS PRT (Primary Teacher) 2026
initialExam.description: Recruitment of Primary Teachers (PRT) in Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas across India. NVS schools are residential schools for talented rural students under the Ministry of Education.
initialExam.syllabus: Reasoning Ability (Analogy, Classification, Series, Coding-Decoding, Blood Relations, Puzzles), General Awareness (History, Geography, Polity, Economy, Science, Current Affairs), Hindi & English Language (Comprehension, Grammar, Vocabulary, Error Detection), Quantitative Aptitude (Number System, Percentage, Ratio, Profit & Loss, Time & Work, Mensuration), Subject Knowledge & Pedagogy (Child Development, Teaching Methodologies, Learning Theories, Classroom Management, Assessment Techniques).
initialExam.examPattern: Paper I: Reasoning + Language + Quantitative Aptitude + General Awareness - 100 marks, 3 hours. Paper II: Subject Knowledge & Pedagogy - 50 marks (combined). Total 150 marks CBT. No negative marking.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Computer Based Test (CBT) → Document Verification → Medical Examination → Final Merit List

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years

initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Free Accommodation (residential campus), Medical, LTC, Pension (NPS), Children Education Allowance, Summer & Winter Vacations
initialExam.careerGrowth: PRT → TGT (through promotion/LDCE) → PGT → Vice Principal → Principal.
initialExam.jobRole: Teaching primary classes (I-V) in Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas including lesson planning, student assessment, and co-curricular activities.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit navodaya.gov.in 2. Register on recruitment portal 3. Fill application form 4. Upload documents, photo & signature 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
